hero.headline: Mental health support that helps you
hero.subtitle: Connect with licensed psychologists and take control of your emotional wellbeing. Sessions run on Google Meet — no new apps, no friction.

lucia.quote: After losing my mum I didn't know where to start. My psychologist helped me face my grief — and we even worked through my social media addiction together. Tracking my screen time was a turning point I never expected.
lucia.author: Lucía F.

tomas.quote: GetBetter gave my practice the reach it deserved. Booking is seamless, and my patients show up to Google Meet sessions already feeling supported.
tomas.author: Dr. Tomás Herrera

elena.quote: I love that everything lives in one place. I open a slot, a patient books it, and we're on Google Meet — no back-and-forth emails, no scheduling chaos. My practice has never run more smoothly.
elena.author: Dra. Elena Martínez

footer.tagline: Made to connect patients and psychologists.
